errors.evidence: The figure shows the absolute low point appears to be closer to approximately -6 Euro/MWh, which the description states as 'exakt -6'. This is consistent with the y-axis markings. However, the trough visually appears to reach approximately -6, so this claim is acceptable.

The description mentions the tick interval of 1 on the y-axis, but the y-axis actually shows ticks at intervals of 1 (from -7 to 3), which appears correct. However, the description does not note that not all integer values may have explicit tick labels shown, though this is a minor omission.
